payload.author: claude
payload.body: Epic complete. Postgres storage half: FR-118 async seam, FR-119–122 adapters, FR-24 PG search, FR-146 keystone (createFrickServer runs on PG), FR-25 backup/restore parity. Horizontal-scale half: FR-27 RedisClusterBus, FR-28 multi-node-safe job/platform claims (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED). FR-145 per-stream retention. All validated against a real Postgres/Redis. FR-23 cancelled (superseded by FR-118–122).
